AutomaticProcessingTest.pins: XR_microscopeAutomaticProcessing on existing data (streaming false), following demos/demo_microscope_pipeline_single_dataset*.m and demos/demo_microscope_pipeline_multiple_dataset.m: flat field correction, combined deskew/rotation, and stitching in DSR space.

clusterModeDoesNotWaitForStepsGivenUp.pins: a step given up (the job of its last try ended without its result) doesn't hold the wait for the results still to come: tile 1's job is gone at the second round, tile 2's runs, and tile 2's result comes during the first second of the second wait, after which the pipeline goes on (and ends)

clusterModeEndsSoonAfterTheLastResults.pins: the pipeline waited the whole wait between its rounds (0.3 s per unfinished file, at least 3 s), so it saw the last results up to that late; it now looks for the results still to come each second and goes on once they are all there. The fake jobs don't run; their results come during the second second.

clusterModeFindsTheResultOfTilesWithOthe.pins: a stitched volume has the msec field of its first tile, which other tiles' msec fields may differ from, but each file looked for the result by its own: the dataset's stitching job was submitted again for the other files. The tiles were deskewed before; the stitching job doesn't run, its result comes at the second wait.

clusterModeLooksForTheStitchedResultEach.pins: (as clusterModeEndsSoonAfterTheLastResults, for the stitched result, which the pipeline finds by a pattern) the tiles were deskewed before; the stitching job doesn't run, its result comes during the third second, after its temporary folder (which doesn't count) during the second

clusterModeSeesResultsOtherNodesJustMade.pins: on NFS, exist() can miss a file another node just made for 30 s or more, so the pipeline saw finished deskew results a round late; it now checks them with batch_file_exist, which sees them at once. The stub reports them made, so no job is submitted.

clusterModeSubmitsStitchingAfterTheDeske.pins: a dataset's stitching job was submitted right after the deskew job of its first file, so on a busy cluster it took a slot ahead of the dataset's other deskew jobs, only to wait for their results; it is now submitted after them

clusterModeSubmitsStitchingWhenTilesWere.pins: (with the stitching job after the deskew jobs) the deskewed tile of a file done before needs no job: the stitching job follows the deskew job of the other file

clusterModeTellsStitchingThatTilesAreCom.pins: the stitching job gave up a time point whose deskewed tiles were not all there after 3 checks 5 s apart, and the pipeline then needed another stitching job for it (or lost it, after the tries of its stitching, while deskewing took long). While deskew jobs of a dataset are pending or running, a marker in its DSR folder now tells the stitching job that the tiles are coming; it is written again on...

clusterModeWaitGrowsWithUnfinishedFiles.pins: with jobs on the cluster the pipeline always waited 30 s between rounds, so the last results were seen up to 30 s late; it now waits 0.3 s per unfinished file, at least 3 s and at most 30 s (or until the results come, see clusterModeEndsSoonAfterTheLastResults)

clusterModeWaitsForTheLastStitchingTry.pins: after submitting the last try of a dataset's stitching job, the pipeline returned without waiting for it; it now checks the job until it ends, without submitting again

demoParameterSetIsAccepted.pins: the demos used to pass a 4-element Save16bit (for steps that were removed from the pipeline in abd53f9), which the pipeline rejects

deskewMarkerIsRemovedWhenThePipelineStop.pins: an error (or Ctrl-C) in the pipeline must not leave its marker for a stitching job to wait for

deskewRotateAndStitchMultipleDatasets.pins: demo_microscope_pipeline_multiple_dataset.m: two datasets, each with its own image list; tiles overlap in y by 16 rows

flatFieldAndDeskewRotate.pins: demo_microscope_pipeline_single_dataset_nostitch.m: two channels with per channel flat field and background images

imageListsStayWithTheirDatasets.pins: the data paths are sorted (unique), but their image lists kept the given order, so datasets given out of order were stitched with each other's image lists. The stitching wrapper is a spy.

lastTryWaitsForATaskRunnerThatHasTheTask.pins: (task runners) tile 2's job makes its result and then runs tile 3's task (a task runner; tile 1, the first of its kind, runs as before), so tile 3's own job ends at once: the pipeline counts tile 3 as running while tile 2's job runs, instead of as finished (it returned before tile 3 was done), and does not submit it again

localRunSubmitsNoStitchingJobs.pins: the stitching task didn't get parseCluster, so a local run on a machine with Slurm stitched in Slurm jobs

localStitchingFinishesWithoutWaiting.pins: the stitching step looked for its result before computing it, so a local run always idled 30 s before seeing that it was done

localStitchingWithoutResultIsTriedOnce.pins: locally, the stitching of a dataset was called again in every round until its result came (no tries were counted), so a stitching that makes none kept the run going forever. A try counts once the dataset's files are deskewed; the stitching wrapper is a spy that makes no result.

scalarSave16bitIsForBothSteps.pins: save16bit may be one value, but the stitching string took its second (MATLAB:badsubscript after the first file's deskew). The stitching wrapper is a spy.

stitchingGetsTheResampleFactorInItsAxisO.pins: the deskew's resampleFactor is [x y z] (XR_checkResampleSetting), the stitching's [y x z]: it was passed unchanged, so x and y were exchanged in the stitching of factors whose x and y differ. The stitching wrapper is a spy.

stitchingLastTryWaitsForATaskRunnerThatH.pins: (task runners) three datasets: the second dataset's stitching job makes its result and then runs the third dataset's stitching task (a task runner; the first stitching job, the first of its kind, runs as before), so the third one's own job ends at once: the pipeline counts it as running while the second job runs, and does not submit it again

streamingAddsNewFilesNamedAsAnotherDatas.pins: with streaming, a new file was left out if any listed file's name contained its name, of any dataset: in several datasets with the same file names, the later dataset's files were never processed. A file of the second dataset named as the first's arrives at the first wait.

streamingLeavesOutRecentFilesWithTheirSi.pins: in streaming mode, files changed in the last minModifyTime minutes (still being written) are left for later, but their sizes stayed in the list: a cluster run that started with only such files failed (3 sizes for no file), and the files after such a file got the sizes of the files before them

streamingProcessesNewFiles.pins: with streaming on, files that arrive during the run used to make the pipeline fail (it added 4 flag columns to 2)

FilenameParsingTest.pins: the file lists of the pipeline: channel patterns, partial volume files (groupPartialVolumeFiles, XR_parseImageFilenames) and the grouping of the files of a time point by channel (groupImageFilenamesByChannels)

channelPatternThatIsNotARegexp.pins: contains(names, regexpPattern(p)) fails for a pattern with an unmatched '(', '[' or '{', also where the names contain it

channelPatternsStayRegularExpressions.pins: valid patterns are still regular expressions, others text

channelsWithDifferentNumbersOfFiles.pins: a channel without a file left for a group failed (assignment of an empty max); the group gets 0 for it

fileListAsARow.pins: a file list given as a row failed (rows of part names put under the main name)

partialVolumeFlagsAreLogicalWithAnEmptyF.pins: partialvols was double when a folder had no files

partsOfNamesWithRegexpCharacters.pins: the main names were used as regular expressions, so the parts of a name with '+' or '(1)' were lost

SettingFilesTest.pins: the setting files of an acquisition (parseSettingFile): the stage offset, interval and excitation pixels of XR_parseSettingFiles, and the setting file of each image (XR_parseSettingFiles_wrapper)

imageNameThatMatchesNoGrammar.pins: a name that matches no grammar got the folder as its setting file (and failed reading it); it has no setting file: a warning, and NaN setting values

imageWithoutASettingFileKeepsFlipZstack.pins: XR_parseImageFilenames starts each image at flipZstack and the setting files decide; an image without one became not flipped (NaN < 0), now it keeps flipZstack

imagesWithAndWithoutACameraInTheirNames.pins: names with and without a camera were all read with the grammar of names without one: the names with one got the folder as their setting file

lastLineWithoutANewlineIsRead.pins: the last line read was dropped (feof is true once fgetl has read the last line, with or without a final newline), and the stage line pattern needs a newline after the line: a stage line needed two lines after it

missingFilesAreNamedInTheWarning.pins: a missing first file failed (its warning used an undefined name), a missing later file was named as the file before it

onlyTheFirstHundredLinesAreRead.pins: the stage line can be the 100th line (it was the last line kept, without a newline after it), not the 101st
